about_the_game:
The cats are done saving the world and scaring — it’s time to relax! Welcome to the new FREE expansion for Cast Cats, where our fluffy friends grab their beach towels and head out on vacation!

Enjoy 14 chill levels and 1 secret one, hidden deep in the sands. In this pack, you'll see the cats doing what we all dream of: soaking up the sun, munching on juicy watermelons, splashing in the pool, scuba diving, and simply strolling around.

Resort & Paws is summer in a fluffy format! Soak in the warm vibes, breezy illustrations, and festive summer tunes. Forget the rush — it’s time to unwind!

Unlock all the levels and discover the true meaning of doing absolutely nothing... the cat way — because nobody relaxes like a cat!

Features:

  • 14 new levels

  • One secret level

  • New soundtrack

  • New Steam achievement

  • The game is suitable for children and adults

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400, AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 660, AMD Radeon R9 270X
